heroTitle: Find the right person. Find the right job.
heroSubtitle: DHIIL helps clients and professionals discover each other — then connects you on WhatsApp to talk.
featurePostDesc: Describe what you need, publish it, and share it on WhatsApp.
featureProfileDesc: Show your skills, portfolio, and experience to clients.
featureApplyDesc: Apply to jobs, then continue the conversation on WhatsApp.
howItWorksStep1: Clients post jobs, professionals build profiles.
howItWorksStep2: Professionals apply — DHIIL saves the application and notifies the client.
howItWorksStep3: Clients review, shortlist, and accept applicants.
howItWorksStep4: Either side continues the conversation on WhatsApp.
